posts.title: 五轴加工如何提升复杂零件的生产效率
posts.summary: 一次装夹完成五面加工：五轴联动把复杂零件的工序数与装夹误差同时压下来。
posts.author: AUVEX 工程团队
posts.content:
为什么是五轴

传统三轴加工复杂叶轮与结构件需要多次装夹，每次装夹都引入定位误差。五轴联动在一次装夹内完成五面加工，把累积公差收敛到机床本身的精度等级。

效率账怎么算

以航空发动机机匣为例：三轴方案 6 道工序、11 小时；五轴方案 2 道工序、5 小时，同时把位置度从 ±0.05mm 提升到 ±0.01mm。

选型要点

关注主轴刚性、RTCP 精度与后处理生态——机床只是起点，工艺链才决定交付能力。
posts.i18nJson:
{"en-US":{"title":"How 5-Axis Machining Improves Complex Part Production","summary":"Five-face machining in one setup: 5-axis linkage cuts both operation count and stacking error on complex parts.","content":"

Why five axes

Machining impellers and structural parts on 3-axis machines takes multiple setups, each adding positioning error. 5-axis linkage finishes five faces in one setup, converging cumulative tolerance to the machine's own accuracy class.

Running the numbers

For an aero-engine casing: 6 operations and 11 hours on 3-axis versus 2 operations and 5 hours on 5-axis, with true position improved from ±0.05mm to ±0.01mm.

What to look for

Spindle rigidity, RTCP accuracy and the post-processor ecosystem — the machine is the starting point; the process chain delivers.

"}}

posts.title: 航空航天制造的 CNC 技术趋势
posts.summary: 轻量化结构件、难加工材料与大尺寸整体件，正在重塑航空制造的机床需求。
posts.author: 行业观察
posts.content:
钛合金、高温合金与大尺寸整体构件是航空航天制造的三大挑战。高扭矩主轴、大行程龙门结构与在线检测正在成为新标配。

自动化场景也在快速增长：机器人上下料与多机床柔性线，让夜班也能保持满负荷。
posts.i18nJson:
{"en-US":{"title":"The Future of CNC Machining in Aerospace Manufacturing","summary":"Lightweight structures, hard-to-machine alloys and large monolithic parts are reshaping machine requirements.","content":"

Titanium, superalloys and large monolithic parts are the three challenges of aerospace manufacturing. High-torque spindles, large-travel gantry structures and in-process measurement are becoming standard.

Automation is growing fast too: robot loading and multi-machine flexible lines keep night shifts at full load.

"}}

posts.title: 数控机床长期可靠运行的维护要点
posts.summary: 从导轨润滑到热补偿校准，一套可执行的保养节奏让精度十年如一日。
posts.author: AUVEX 服务部
posts.content:
润滑与导轨

按小时计数而非按天：集中润滑系统的液位与压力要进入每日点检表。

热补偿校准

季节与环境温度变化会漂移定位精度，建议每季度做一次激光干涉仪校准。

备件策略

主轴轴承、密封件与过滤器按运行小时建立更换台账，停机成本远高于备件成本。
posts.i18nJson:
{"en-US":{"title":"CNC Machine Maintenance Best Practices for Long-Term Reliability","summary":"From guideway lubrication to thermal calibration — an executable service rhythm keeps accuracy intact for a decade.","content":"

Lubrication and guideways

Count by hours, not days: central lube level and pressure belong on the daily checklist.

Thermal calibration

Seasonal temperature shifts drift positioning accuracy — schedule a laser-interferometer check every quarter.

Spares strategy

Track spindle bearings, seals and filters by running hours; downtime costs far more than spares.

"}}

posts.title: 航空发动机机匣五轴加工案例
posts.summary: 钛合金机匣从三轴 6 道工序到五轴 2 道工序：精度与工时的双重收敛。
posts.author: AUVEX 工程团队
posts.content:
客户原三轴方案加工钛合金机匣需要 6 道工序、11 小时，装夹误差累积导致位置度徘徊在 ±0.05mm。切换 VX-650 五轴方案后：2 道工序、5 小时，位置度收敛到 ±0.01mm。

RTCP 全程补偿与切削参数库是关键——机床只是起点，工艺包才是交付能力。
posts.i18nJson:
{"en-US":{"title":"Aerospace Engine Housing Machining Case","summary":"Titanium housings: from 6 operations on 3-axis to 2 operations on 5-axis — accuracy and hours converge.","content":"

The customer's 3-axis process machined titanium housings in 6 operations and 11 hours, with true position stuck at ±0.05mm. Moving to the VX-650: 2 operations, 5 hours, true position converged to ±0.01mm.

Full-travel RTCP compensation and a cutting-parameter library made the difference — the machine is the start; the process package is the delivery.

"}}
